aboutSubheading: Serving Ringwood and Melbourne's Eastern Suburbs for over 15 years
aboutText: SparkRight Electrical has been proudly servicing Ringwood, Croydon, Ringwood East and the greater Eastern Suburbs for more than 15 years. Our team of fully licensed and insured electricians brings honest, reliable workmanship to every job — from simple power point installs to full home rewires. With a 4.9-star Google rating from over 187 reviews, our customers trust us to get it done right the first time.
